abstract: Seven patients with testicular tumor were reviewed. Among them were two patients with cryptorchidism which had not been suspected. All were treated with orchidectomy through an inguinal incision or by laparotomy. Afterwards the seminomata underwent radiation therapy, and in the malignant teratoma intermediate, when ever possible, a retroperitoneal lymphnode dissection was done. The malignant teratoma undifferentiated (stage IV) received chemotherapy (cis-diamminodichloroplatinum) with good results. The lymphoblastic sarcoma (stage IV) was treated with methotrexate and vincristine. It is suggested that in patients with cryptorchidism the undescended or intra-abdominal testis should always be explored, and excised if suspect or underdeveloped.
abstract_ja: 精巣腫瘍の患者7例を検討した。そのうち2例は、それまで気づかれていなかった停留精巣を合併していた。全例に鼠径部切開または開腹による精巣摘除術を施行した。セミノーマには放射線療法を行い、中間型悪性奇形腫では可能な限り後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した。未分化型悪性奇形腫（病期IV）にはシスプラチンによる化学療法を行い、良好な結果が得られた。リンパ芽球性肉腫（病期IV）にはメトトレキサートとビンクリスチンを用いた。停留精巣や腹腔内の精巣は、疑わしい場合や発育不全の場合には探索し、切除すべきである。
